title: Successful bidders can lose significant value due to division rounding
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as possibly significant value will be lost  **Likelihood:** High, as it will happen with most bids  ## Description  The `fulfillWindow` method calculates the auction reserves and proceeds after a successful bid in a window.
